This review of the HAVN HS 360 case analyzes thermal performance, acoustics, and build quality. We previously reviewed HAVN's HS 420, which we tested overall positively; however, at the time, we found its vertical GPU solution to be only partially effective. Now, the HS 360 adds a second glass sheet to help trap and direct air to the GPU. The HS 360 is shipping into a bad PC DIY market, unfortunately, but remains an interesting test subject for vertical GPU thermals. Competition is stiff from Cooler Master, Lian Li, Fractal, Hyte, and others in the $200 range.
